page.overview:
Who is Xiaan Amersu?

Xiaan Amersu was a female Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Knight who fought during the Clone Wars. She was the Padawan of J'Mikel, an Anx Jedi she saw killed by the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. Amersu was later put in care of Jedi physicians to free her mind of the horror she witnessed. Afterwards, she met with Quinlan Vos in the Mediation Garden within the Coruscant Jedi Temple and gifted Vos the Heart of Fire so that he could use his ability of psychometry to remember his Padawan, Aayla Secura.

By the time of the Clone Wars, Amersu had reached the rank of Jedi Knight. During the Siege of Saleucami, she flew as Blue Leader and sacrificed herself and her fighter to eliminate a Separatist planetary gun.

A member of the Jedi Order, Xiaan Amersu was a Twi'lek female from the planet Ryloth. Whilst in the Jedi Temple located on the planet Coruscant, Amersu was approached by Padawan Aayla Secura who presented her with a Heart of Fire, a stone that Secura's master had given her during her training.

In 30 BBY, the pair were exploring the Coruscant underworld in the Temple Precinct with Master Peerce searching for the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. They followed a trail of blood, coming across the corpses of four Republic Peace Officers killed by Sing. J'Mikel apologized to Amersu on the matters of seeing the tragic scene, with Amersu remarking that the officers were with the Force. The group split up, with Peerce finding the missing fifth Duros Republic Peace Officer tied up.
